snippet.title: The Eminence in Shadow: Phantom Echoes - First Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
The first-ever console game for The Eminence in Shadow is coming!
The Eminence in Shadow: Phantom Echoes is set for release in 2027!
This title will be a rogue-lite action game.
